_comment: Frontend literal scan allowlist. Each entry is a frontend-relative POSIX path exempted from the India-literal scan. Phase 1 of v3 establishes the containment perimeter: existing India-specific UI surfaces are allowlisted; future code that adds an India literal in a non-allowlisted file fails the scan. Phase 5 region-gating reduces the entries.

allowlist.reason: Last-resort India fallback list; gated behind India region check at the call site.

Multi-region currency / locale / symbol lookup table. India is one row in a 13-currency table; the hook itself never assumes India and the table is ALSO the source of truth for USD/EUR/GBP/JPY/etc. mappings.
